title: Four pairs become one scalar
purpose: Match reduction index k, multiply each pair, then sum the four products.
contract: a [4] dot x [4] gives one scalar; F32 inputs and accumulator.
Empty dot returns zero; unequal lengths and non-vector ranks are errors.
caption: Match reduction index k, multiply each pair, then sum the four products. a [4] dot x [4] gives one scalar; F32 inputs and accumulator. Products [2,-2,-3,0]; increasing-k partial sums [2,0,-3,-3]. Empty dot returns zero; unequal lengths and non-vector ranks are errors.
